{{Quote|CorSec, ImpSec. How am I supposed to keep track of all these details? Just help get me off this world.|Naz Tulos|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Naz Tulos''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilot]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Shalera]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with rescuing Tulos after he attacked a [[Corellian Security Force]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]], mistaking them for [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]].<ref name="AED" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:StrandedRebelPilotTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Randomly generated depictions of Naz Tulos]]
Naz Tulos was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" />
